comparisons.name: window-light
comparisons.description: The whole Aqua capture: the Siri window with its shadow, answering with the Weather result. The window was captured with the desktop picture blended into its materials and nothing behind it, so the example puts an element behind the window (grey #757575, over which the HUD material measures #383838, with the aqua cast of the capture) and sets --mac-siri-card-glow for the light in the card. What differs here is the text, in the fallback font, the weather glyphs and header icon, which are plain shapes, and the orb, which is the library's own drawing.

comparisons.name: window-light-chrome
comparisons.description: As window-light with the card's text and glyphs and the orb masked, to score the window alone: chrome, edge, shadow, strips, lines, buttons, and the card with its corners and header band.

comparisons.name: window-dark
comparisons.description: The whole Dark Aqua capture. The window is the same as in Aqua; the capture differs in the result and in the desktop picture, for which the element behind the window and --mac-siri-card-glow stand in as explained for window-light, here with warm and pink casts.

comparisons.name: window-dark-chrome
comparisons.description: As window-dark with the card's text and glyphs and the orb masked, to score the window alone. The mean difference is higher than in Aqua because the casts of this desktop picture are stronger and the gradients follow them only roughly.

comparisons.name: parts-light
comparisons.description: A short window, listening at full level with the waveform still, on the flat grey over which the HUD material measures #383838, Aqua. The window does not differ between the appearances.
